IL.xhtml:p:
(* Determine State *) LD State EQ 0 JMPC state_stopped
LD State EQ 1 JMPC state_running
LD State EQ 2 JMPC state_manual
JMPC exit_prg
state_stopped: LD 1 ST Stopped_led LD 0 ST Manual_led ST Running_led JMP exit_prg
state_running: LD 1 ST Running_led LD 0 ST Manual_led ST Stopped_led JMP exit_prg
state_manual: LD 1 ST Manual_led LD 0 ST Running_led ST Stopped_led JMP exit_prg
exit_prg:
